records.subject: You're in -- let's get Quartz Analytics set up
records.body:
Hi Maya,

Welcome! A lot of new teams ask us the same thing in the first few days: how do I get my team in here. Short answer -- a teammate can be invited from Account Settings -> Members at any time.

Reply any time.

Cheers,
Priya Chen

records.text: :tada: New signup: *Quartz Analytics* just joined on the starter plan!

decisions.rationale: Positive momentum: first_project reached day 1, one invite sent, admin replied warmly saying it's "starting to click" [email:a8648d19]; no tickets or blockers, 8 days left. But key_milestone still unreached at day 6 and only one teammate on Starter, so follow-through is uncertain.

draft.subject: Re: How's the first week going?
draft.body:
Hi Maya,

Great to hear the first project is starting to click — and that you're not solo in there anymore.

Since projects are the main organizing unit and tasks live inside them, the next step that usually makes things stick is getting real work into that project. Want me to look at how you've got it structured and suggest where tasks would fit? Just reply with a bit about the work your team is tracking and I'll come back with something concrete.

Best,
Priya
